math_difficulty.definition: Easy levels 1–2, hard levels 4–5. Negative hard-minus-easy relative change indicates stronger proportional shortening on hard tasks.

observational_compute_matches.method: Observational same-problem pairs with fewer written reasoning tokens at higher depth and completion_tokens*(passes+1) within 5/10/20%. The proxy counts repeated transformer layers (12 outer + 12 per pass); it excludes prefill, KV memory, and scheduling. Selection uses realized output length, so these are descriptive subsets, not causal compute-controlled experiments. Whole-cohort batch tradeoffs are also retained for every observed main-run pass pair, without selecting individual problems by outcome; a within-10%-wall-time flag marks naturally similar observed batch budgets, not a controlled budget intervention.

statistical_method.mcnemar: Exact two-sided binomial test on paired discordant counts
statistical_method.primary_multiple_comparisons: Holm over MATH 3-versus-4, 3-versus-5, 3-versus-6; other comparisons exploratory
statistical_method.math_accuracy: Equal level weighting, 40 per level; stratified problem bootstrap
statistical_method.repeat_note: Three observations per repeated setting; use the shared 100-MATH/164-code subset, never pool repeated problems as independent samples.
